_comment: MA3 Visualization Tab Feedback Messages - Instructors can edit these
BIN_ALL_CORRECT: All bin table formulas are correct. Your Min, Max, and Width calculations are properly set up.
BIN_PARTIAL: {correct} out of 3 bin table formulas are correct. Please review the issues noted below.
BIN_NONE_CORRECT: None of the bin table formulas are correct. Please use MIN for the minimum, MAX for the maximum, and (Max-Min)/bins for the width.
BIN_MIN_OK: Your Bin Min formula in E22 is correct and uses the MIN function to find the smallest difference value.
BIN_MIN_WRONG: The Bin Min formula in E22 is incorrect. Please use the MIN function referencing the difference data (D14:D63).
BIN_MIN_MISSING: The Bin Min formula in E22 is missing. Please enter a MIN function to find the smallest value in the difference data.
BIN_MAX_OK: Your Bin Max formula in E23 is correct and uses the MAX function to find the largest difference value.
BIN_MAX_WRONG: The Bin Max formula in E23 is incorrect. Please use the MAX function referencing the difference data (D14:D63).
BIN_MAX_MISSING: The Bin Max formula in E23 is missing. Please enter a MAX function to find the largest value in the difference data.
BIN_WIDTH_OK: Your Bin Width formula in E24 is correct and properly calculates (Max - Min) divided by the number of bins.
BIN_WIDTH_WRONG: The Bin Width formula in E24 is incorrect. It should calculate (Max - Min) divided by the number of bins.
BIN_WIDTH_MISSING: The Bin Width formula in E24 is missing. Please enter a formula that calculates the bin width as (Max - Min) / number of bins.
FREQ_LIMITS_ALL_CORRECT: All Lower Limit and Upper Limit formulas in the frequency table are correct.
FREQ_LIMITS_PARTIAL: {correct} out of {total} Lower/Upper Limit formulas are correct. Please review the issues noted below.
FREQ_LIMITS_NONE_CORRECT: None of the Lower/Upper Limit formulas are correct. The Lower Limit should reference the previous Upper Limit, and the Upper Limit should add the bin width.
FREQ_LOWER_OK: Your Lower Limit formula in {cell} is correct.
FREQ_LOWER_WRONG: The Lower Limit formula in {cell} is incorrect. It should reference the Bin Min for the first row, or the previous Upper Limit for subsequent rows.
FREQ_LOWER_MISSING: The Lower Limit formula in {cell} is missing.
FREQ_UPPER_OK: Your Upper Limit formula in {cell} is correct.
FREQ_UPPER_WRONG: The Upper Limit formula in {cell} is incorrect. It should equal the Lower Limit plus the Bin Width.
FREQ_UPPER_MISSING: The Upper Limit formula in {cell} is missing.
FREQ_DIST_ALL_CORRECT: All Title of Bin, Frequency, and Relative Frequency formulas are correct.
FREQ_DIST_PARTIAL: {correct} out of {total} frequency distribution formulas are correct. Please review the issues noted below.
FREQ_DIST_NONE_CORRECT: None of the frequency distribution formulas are correct. Please verify your Title of Bin, Frequency, and Relative Frequency calculations.
FREQ_TITLE_OK: Your Title of Bin formula in {cell} is correct and calculates the midpoint of the bin.
FREQ_TITLE_WRONG: The Title of Bin formula in {cell} is incorrect. It should calculate the midpoint as (Lower Limit + Upper Limit) / 2.
FREQ_TITLE_MISSING: The Title of Bin formula in {cell} is missing. Please enter a formula that calculates the midpoint of each bin.
FREQ_COUNT_OK: Your Frequency formula in {cell} is correct and counts the values within the bin range.
FREQ_COUNT_WRONG: The Frequency formula in {cell} is incorrect. Please use COUNTIF, COUNTIFS, or FREQUENCY to count values within each bin's range.
FREQ_COUNT_MISSING: The Frequency formula in {cell} is missing. Please enter a counting function to determine how many values fall within this bin.
FREQ_REL_OK: Your Relative Frequency formula in {cell} is correct.
FREQ_REL_WRONG: The Relative Frequency formula in {cell} is incorrect. It should divide the frequency by the total number of data points.
FREQ_REL_MISSING: The Relative Frequency formula in {cell} is missing. Please enter a formula that calculates frequency divided by total.
HIST_ALL_CORRECT: Your histogram is complete with the correct data source, chart title, and axis titles.
HIST_PARTIAL: Your histogram meets {correct} out of 6 criteria. Please review the issues noted below.
HIST_MISSING: No histogram or bar chart was found on the Visualization tab. Please create a bar chart using your frequency data.
HIST_FOUND: A bar chart is present on the Visualization tab.
HIST_WRONG_TYPE: A chart was found but it is not a bar chart. Please use a bar chart (column chart) for the histogram.
HIST_DATA_OK: Your chart correctly uses the Frequency column as its data source.
HIST_DATA_WRONG: The chart data range is incorrect. The chart should use the Frequency column (G28:G38 or similar) as its values.
HIST_DATA_MISSING: Could not verify the chart's data range. Please ensure the chart references the Frequency column.
HIST_LABELS_OK: Your chart correctly uses the Title of Bin column for category labels.
HIST_LABELS_WRONG: The chart category labels are incorrect. The chart should use the Title of Bin column (F28:F38 or similar) for the horizontal axis labels.
HIST_LABELS_MISSING: The chart is missing category labels. Please set the Title of Bin column as the category (horizontal) axis labels.
HIST_TITLE_MISSING: Your chart is missing a title. Please add an appropriate title describing what the histogram displays.
HIST_XAXIS_MISSING: Your chart's X-axis is missing a title. The X-axis should be labeled to describe the bin categories.
HIST_YAXIS_MISSING: Your chart's Y-axis is missing a title. The Y-axis should be labeled 'Frequency' or similar.
VIS_FORMAT_ALL_CORRECT: All cells on the Visualization tab are formatted correctly.
VIS_FORMAT_PARTIAL: {correct} out of {total} cells are formatted correctly. Please review the formatting issues noted below.
VIS_FORMAT_CELL_WRONG: Cell {cell} is not formatted correctly. Please check the number format requirements.
